description_expanded: OverviewCommunity Pool, 50 Steps to the Beach, Sleeps 4, Newly Decorated! 'BeeBy The Shore'The Space Bee By the Shore – Gulf-View Condo Steps from the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Prime Inlet Beach Location – Just steps from white sand beaches & Cobia Reef 1 Bedroom + Built-In Bunks – Sleeps up to 4 guests comfortably Private Balcony – Enjoy morning coffee with tranquil Gulf views Fully Equipped Kitchen – Modern appliances & everything you need for easy meals High-Speed Wi-Fi & Cable TV – Stay connected & entertained King Master Suite – Spacious & cozy retreat with a flat-screen TV Newly Renovated Bathroom – Featuring a large walk-in shower Community Pool & Grill Area – Relax & unwind just steps from your door Ideal for Paddleboarding & Snorkeling – Located near Cobia Reef’s marine life Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free stayWelcome to BeeBy The ShoreWelcome to Bee By the Shore, a newly-decorated one-bedroom condo ideally situated on the 2nd floor in Inlet Beach, FL. This charming retreat is just steps away from the renowned white sand beaches and offers sweeping Gulf views.Across from the property lies Cobia Reef, an artificial reef teeming with marine life, perfect for paddleboarding or guided tours. Inside, the living space features a cozy arrangement of a living room with modern amenities including cable TV and high-speed Wi-Fi, dining area, and a fully-equipped kitchen.Step out onto the balcony through sliding glass doors to savor morning coffee amidst tranquil views of lush trees and distant ocean sounds. Additional sleeping arrangements include custom-built twin over twin bunks tucked away in the hallway, ideal for children or extra guests. The King Master Suite provides a peaceful sanctuary with a comfortable bed, flat-screen TV, dresser, and ample closet space. Refresh in the newly-renovated bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower. Community amenities include access to a pool and grill, ensuring a relaxing stay at Bee By the Shore where coastal serenity meets modern comfort.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4)Master bedroom - King sized bedCommon Space - Twin bunk bedShow less
